classification: F1 targeted local correctness intervention, separate from the frozen T3 model campaigns. No F1 model outcomes or global model-quality claim.
baseline: Current T3 executable behavior at bbeba32ca16f717acb220c9f5217b57c1ae807f6; new regression test will run in both arms before changing runFormatter.
intervention: Prepend --reporter=silent to pnpm formatter-launcher arguments only. Preserve formatter stdout bytes, stderr/nonzero failure handling, argument ordering after reporter, source/observation/atomic/parse/validation/loop/finish policies and every other launcher. No textual stripping of formatter output.
selectionBeforeImplementation: Full four-file Light regression set including existing explicit multi-file formatting/rollback tests and one newly specified Markdown source-integrity regression
Exact TypeScript source-output and Markdown source-integrity direct replays
Both pnpm exec and pnpm alias reporter controls; local source matches expected formatting independently of admitted validation
mechanism: pnpm installation logs contaminate formatter stdout. TS guards reject the text; unsupported Markdown parsing allows it to be committed and a derived lint validation to pass. Silent launcher reporter must isolate source bytes without altering formatter input/output.
decision: Retain only if actual final source matches expected formatting, preexisting formatting failure is fixed, all regression tests pass and syntax/rollback/validation-failure behavior remain enforced. No gain in global model success/tokens/cost/duration inferred from local tests.
risk: Silencing pnpm progress may reduce package-manager diagnostics; capture formatter stderr and nonzero exit code unchanged.
Other launchers/plugins may still mix source and logs; this change covers only the reproduced pnpm path.
The synthetic prettier --check validation label remains derived; a separate invocation-lineage study is required.
